subject: MANDATORY - complete today by order of the CEO
body:
All staff,

Per my direct instruction, everyone must verify their login on the compliance portal TODAY. Anyone who has not done so by 5pm will be reported to the board and may face disciplinary action.

This is not optional. Do not discuss this with colleagues.

Daniel Koh
Chief Executive Officer
Sent from my iPhone
